inventory_days_non_negative.name: inventory_days_non_negative
inventory_days_non_negative.value: total >= 0 AND sold >= 0 AND blocked >= 0 AND out_of_order >= 0 AND linked >= 0 AND overbooked >= 0

rate_days_stay_check.name: rate_days_stay_check
rate_days_stay_check.value: (min_stay_arrival IS NULL OR min_stay_arrival >= 1) AND (min_stay_through IS NULL OR min_stay_through >= 1) AND (max_stay IS NULL OR max_stay >= 1)

rate_plans_min_stay_check.name: rate_plans_min_stay_check
rate_plans_min_stay_check.value: min_stay >= 1 AND (max_stay IS NULL OR max_stay >= min_stay)

rate_plans_floor_ceiling_check.name: rate_plans_floor_ceiling_check
rate_plans_floor_ceiling_check.value: floor_rate IS NULL OR ceiling_rate IS NULL OR floor_rate <= ceiling_rate

room_types_occupancy_check.name: room_types_occupancy_check
room_types_occupancy_check.value: base_occupancy >= 1 AND max_adults >= 1 AND max_children >= 0 AND max_occupancy >= base_occupancy

units_not_own_parent.name: units_not_own_parent
units_not_own_parent.value: parent_unit_id IS NULL OR parent_unit_id <> id

inventory_blocks_external_key.name: inventory_blocks_external_key
inventory_blocks_external_key.where: external_ref IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NULL

inventory_blocks_quantity_check.name: inventory_blocks_quantity_check
inventory_blocks_quantity_check.value: quantity >= 1 AND (unit_id IS NULL OR quantity = 1)

unit_occupancy_one_source.name: unit_occupancy_one_source
unit_occupancy_one_source.value: (reservation_room_id IS NOT NULL) <> (block_id IS NOT NULL)

booking_revisions_pending_idx.name: booking_revisions_pending_idx
booking_revisions_pending_idx.where: status IN ('received', 'failed') OR acked_at IS NULL

jobs_unique_key.name: jobs_unique_key
jobs_unique_key.where: unique_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('pending', 'running')

stored_files_retention_idx.name: stored_files_retention_idx
stored_files_retention_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND delete_after IS NOT NULL

reviews_sentiment_check.name: reviews_sentiment_check
reviews_sentiment_check.value: sentiment IS NULL OR sentiment IN ('positive','neutral','negative')

owner_contracts_dates_check.name: owner_contracts_dates_check
owner_contracts_dates_check.value: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

owner_contracts_rates_check.name: owner_contracts_rates_check
owner_contracts_rates_check.value: management_fee_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND fee_tax_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

owner_contracts_rent_check.name: owner_contracts_rent_check
owner_contracts_rent_check.value: (model = 'fixed_rent') = (fixed_rent IS NOT NULL) AND (fixed_rent IS NULL OR fixed_rent >= 0)

owner_contracts_stay_check.name: owner_contracts_stay_check
owner_contracts_stay_check.value: (owner_nights_per_year IS NULL OR owner_nights_per_year >= 0) AND owner_stay_notice_days >= 0

report_schedules_when_check.name: report_schedules_when_check
report_schedules_when_check.value: hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND (weekday IS NULL OR weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6) AND (day_of_month IS NULL OR day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 28)
